fieldValues.title: Replace normativeSites.expositionRoles with normativeSites.types
fieldValues.summary: check-spec-language's registry named an exposition_role field the srs#556 ruling forecloses forever. Replaced normativeSites.expositionRoles with normativeSites.types (typeNamespace/typeName pairs), rekeyed isNormative in check-spec-language.mjs off the record's own Type, reworded five newly-surfaced rationale-field violations in place rather than growing the allowlist, and added a guard case proving the type-keyed site.
